mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT h.province FROM hospital h INNER JOIN hospital_agency_relation r ON h.id = r.hospital_id WHERE h.province IS NOT NULL AND h.province != ''
SELECT DISTINCT h.city FROM hospital h INNER JOIN hospital_agency_relation r ON h.id = r.hospital_id WHERE h.province = #{province} AND h.city IS NOT NULL AND h.city != ''
SELECT DISTINCT h.* FROM hospital h INNER JOIN hospital_agency_relation r ON h.id = r.hospital_id WHERE h.city = #{city}
